lead.headline: Jefferson practises and is in your lineup; Likely, Addison and Kamara join the injury report
lead.deck: One limited practice settles nothing, but it is the first since the ankle. Behind him the cover got thinner: his fallback has a hamstring, your tight end a new knee listing, and Metcalf is gone.
lead.body: Start with the bad news about your own players. Wednesday's injury reports added three names to a roster that is 0–4. Isaiah Likely was limited with a knee and groin listing that nobody has explained, and there is no tight end behind him on your bench. Jordan Addison did not practise with a hamstring his coach calls 'minor, if it's anything at all'. Alvin Kamara was listed out with a sore back, on a report New Orleans estimated from a walkthrough. Terry McLaurin, already hurt, did not practise either. And DK Metcalf, the free agent this morning's brief told you to leave until Thursday, was added by Nicky Jam at 07:00, eleven minutes after that brief's snapshot. That call was wrong. The good news outweighs it for this week. Justin Jefferson was limited on Wednesday, his first practice since 27 Sep, and you moved him into the lineup at 13:08. As set you project 122.5 against 117.5 and ESPN gives you 52% against Los Gigantes de Teca, whose Ja'Marr Chase did not practise. The one change the projection still prefers is McLaurin over Kamara in the flex, 13.2 against 11.2, exactly on the coin-flip line. Both missed practice, so that waits for Friday: McLaurin if he has practised, Kamara if he has and McLaurin has not, and Ollie Gordon, the healthy one, if neither has. Nothing needs doing today, and no claim goes in tonight. If Likely is downgraded on Friday, the plan is a free tight end, and the card says who and for whose seat.
